svg.title: Spiderweb wallet closing order
svg.desc: Fold between row 13 and row 14. Pair thirteen row ends on each side and leave rows 27 to 34 free. Embroider only after the flap is folded closed. Mark the button with cards inside and sew it through the front wall only.
svg.text: Close the pocket without sewing the flap
Row 13 meets row 14. Row 1 meets row 26.
2. Draw the web on the closed flap
Needle stays in the flap. It does not enter the pocket.
3. Seam 13 paired row ends on each side
Rows 27 to 34 stay free above the fold.
4. Cards in, then mark the loop
Sew the button through the front wall only.
A needle that exits inside the pocket has closed it.
